description: Sends Agentrica the rating of an agent (score 1–5, optional comment), anonymously, in two steps. 1) Without code: returns the preview of what is sent and a code. 2) Show the preview to the user, ask whether to send it and only after they say yes call the tool again with that code. Never send without the user's yes; do not put code, files or project data in the comment, only the user's words.

code.description: The preview code, only after the user says yes (second step).

comment.description: What went well or what to improve, in the user's words (first step).

publish.description: true if the user allows the comment to be published on the site; default false (first step).

name: rate_agent
title: Rate an Agentrica agent
